record: why rung 3 cannot have two eligible cells, 2026-11-16
reading: the numeric gate leaves A, C and D; A and D are assemblers and emit no tag-role claims at all (A 19 flags, all value_not_stored; D 7), so C is the only passer the mechanism instrument can score
consequence: with the floors applied to passers, the D32 requirement of two eligible cells is unsatisfiable by construction, not by missing work
